HR Policies & Employee Guidelines
Key policies and workplace guidelines applicable to all employees at Logikview Analytics.
1

Leave Policy

  • Employees are entitled to 1 credit leave per month, subject to the applicable leave policy.
  • Planned leave of more than 2 consecutive working days must be applied for at least 1 week in advance.
  • Leave approval is subject to business requirements and reporting manager approval.
2

Appraisal Policy

  • Employees become eligible for their performance appraisal after completing 1 year of service.
  • Appraisals are based on individual performance, responsibilities, contribution and company requirements.
3

Notice Period

  • The applicable notice period is 2 months for both the employee and the employer, as per the terms of employment.
  • Employees are required to complete the applicable notice period unless an exception is approved by management.
4

Work From Home (WFH)

  • Employees may avail a maximum of 1 WFH day per week (enforced by the system).
  • WFH is not allowed on Mondays or Fridays.
  • WFH must be approved in advance by the reporting manager.
  • WFH approval may depend on work requirements and business needs.
5

Working Hours

  • Employees are expected to complete 8 working hours per working day.
  • To be eligible for a half-day, an employee must complete at least 4 working hours.
  • Attendance of less than 6 working hours is considered a half-day, subject to the applicable attendance rules.
  • Attendance of less than 4 working hours is considered absent.
6

Sandwich Leave Rule

  • If an employee takes planned leave on both sides of a Saturday and Sunday, the intervening Saturday and Sunday / holiday may also be counted as leave, as per the Sandwich Leave Rule.
7

Regularization

  • Regularization requests are raised by the employee; the system does not create them automatically.
  • A maximum of 3 regularization requests per calendar month may be raised.
  • Each request needs manager / HR approval; once approved, the day is marked present.
8

Comp-off

  • Comp-off is credited for approved work done on a holiday or week-off.
  • A comp-off request follows the same approval route as leave: reporting manager, then HR.
  • Comp-off must be availed within the period defined by HR.
9

Policy Compliance

  • All employees are expected to follow the above policies and any additional HR policies communicated by the company from time to time.
  • The company reserves the right to amend, update or introduce policies based on business and organizational requirements.
For any clarification on these policies, please contact the HR team.
